Reference implementation (Python 3.12+):
```python
def reverse_list(head):
    previous, current = None, head
    while current:
        following = current.next
        current.next = previous
        previous, current = current, following
    return previous

class Node:
    def __init__(self, value, next_node=None): self.value, self.next = value, next_node
def traverse(head):
    out=[]
    while head: out.append(head.value); head=head.next
    return out

head = Node(1, Node(2, Node(3)))
assert traverse(reverse_list(head)) == [3, 2, 1]
```
explanation: Reverse links iteratively with previous/current/following references. Time O(n), auxiliary space O(1).
